prompt: The first-person perspective begins with a slow, steady walk along a narrow, mist-covered path flanked by dense foliage and trees, creating an eerie, enclosed atmosphere. The camera moves forward, capturing the dimly lit surroundings as the fog thickens, obscuring distant views and casting a pale, ghostly light over the scene. As the path progresses, the viewer approaches a partially visible house shrouded in mist, its details faint and indistinct. The camera continues to advance, revealing a stone archway that frames the foggy landscape beyond. The movement is smooth, maintaining a consistent pace as the path winds through the overgrown vegetation and past weathered structures. The environment is quiet and desolate, with no signs of human presence, enhancing the sense of isolation. The camera angle remains at eye level, providing an immersive experience as it navigates through the narrow passages and up a set of stone steps leading to another section of the path. The lighting remains consistently low, with the fog diffusing any available light, casting everything in muted, shadowy tones. The scene transitions seamlessly from one segment of the path to another, each turn revealing more of the abandoned, overgrown setting, emphasizing the solitude and mystery of the night-time exploration on Shengshan Island.
